fullText.simplified:
还有明天

    为什么骑马的声音没有了？那个黑衣人呢？
    孙坚觉得很奇怪，刚在想这些问题，就看到几十支箭从树后面飞了出来。每支箭都对着他，孙坚还没看清楚放箭的人，就从马上掉下去了……
    孙坚身上有很多箭，身上的每个地方都很疼。他耳朵里一点儿声音也没有，他看着黑色的天，有很多话想说，但是什么也说不出来了。他还有很多事没有做，但是都没有机会去做了。他越来越疼，慢慢地看不见东西了……
    孙坚死了。这一年他三十七岁。
    城里的刘表听说孙坚死了，大笑着站起来，说：“太好了！我们打回去！”
    城门打开，刘表带着军队从城里出来了。每个人都高兴地大声说着：“孙坚死了！孙坚死了！”江东军队听了，又急又怕，都问：“他们说的是真的吗？”有人小声说：“好像是真的。”虽然声音很小，但是大家都听到了。每个人都很难过，他们大声地哭了。
    刘表带着军队杀过去，很快就打败了江东军队。
    第二天，孙坚的大儿子孙策来了。他带着被刘表打败的江东军队，和刘表又打了几次。虽然每次都把刘表打败了，但他的人也不多了。
    两天以后，孙策带着死了的孙坚回到了江东。
    孙策站在河边，看着河这边的江东和河那边的荆州。十七岁的他没有哭，他把难过放在了心里。孙坚的助手们站在旁边，他们都很难过，但也很安静。他们都看着孙策，就像以前看着孙坚一样。他们知道，江东还有明天，因为江东人还有孙策。
fullText.traditional:
還有明天

    為什麼騎馬的聲音沒有了？那個黑衣人呢？
    孫堅覺得很奇怪，剛在想這些問題，就看到幾十支箭從樹後面飛了出來。每支箭都對著他，孫堅還沒看清楚放箭的人，就從馬上掉下去了……
    孫堅身上有很多箭，身上的每個地方都很疼。他耳朵裡一點兒聲音也沒有，他看著黑色的天，有很多話想說，但是什麼也說不出來了。他還有很多事沒有做，但是都沒有機會去做了。他越來越疼，慢慢地看不見東西了……
    孫堅死了。這一年他三十七歲。
    城裡的劉表聽說孫堅死了，大笑著站起來，說：“太好了！我們打回去！”
    城門打開，劉表帶著軍隊從城裡出來了。每個人都高興地大聲說著：“孫堅死了！孫堅死了！”江東軍隊聽了，又急又怕，都問：“他們說的是真的嗎？”有人小聲說：“好像是真的。”雖然聲音很小，但是大家都聽到了。每個人都很難過，他們大聲地哭了。
    劉表帶著軍隊殺過去，很快就打敗了江東軍隊。
    第二天，孫堅的大兒子孫策來了。他帶著被劉表打敗的江東軍隊，和劉表又打了幾次。雖然每次都把劉表打敗了，但他的人也不多了。
    兩天以後，孫策帶著死了的孫堅回到了江東。
    孫策站在河邊，看著河這邊的江東和河那邊的荊州。十七歲的他沒有哭，他把難過放在了心裡。孫堅的助手們站在旁邊，他們都很難過，但也很安靜。他們都看著孫策，就像以前看著孫堅一樣。他們知道，江東還有明天，因為江東人還有孫策。

sentences.simplified: 为什么骑马的声音没有了？那个黑衣人呢？
sentences.traditional: 為什麼騎馬的聲音沒有了？那個黑衣人呢？
sentences.pinyin: wèi shén me qí mǎ de shēng yīn méi yǒu le nà ge hēi yī rén ne
sentences.english: Why did the sound of riding on horseback disappear? Where did the man in black go?

sentences.simplified: 孙坚觉得很奇怪，刚在想这些问题，就看到几十支箭从树后面飞了出来。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅覺得很奇怪，剛在想這些問題，就看到幾十支箭從樹後面飛了出來。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān jué de hěn qí guài gāng zài xiǎng zhè xiē wèn tí jiù kàn dào jǐ shí zhī jiàn cóng shù hòu miàn fēi le chu lai
sentences.english: Sun Jian found this very strange. As he was thinking about these things, he saw dozens of arrows fly out from behind the trees.

sentences.simplified: 每支箭都对着他，孙坚还没看清楚放箭的人，就从马上掉下去了……
sentences.traditional: 每支箭都對著他，孫堅還沒看清楚放箭的人，就從馬上掉下去了……
sentences.pinyin: měi zhī jiàn dōu duì zhe tā sūn jiān hái méi kàn qīng chu fàng jiàn de rén jiù cóng mǎ shang diào xià qù le
sentences.english: Every arrow was aimed at him. Sun Jian fell off his horse before he could clearly see who had fired the arrows …

sentences.simplified: 孙坚身上有很多箭，身上的每个地方都很疼。他耳朵里一点儿声音也没有，
sentences.traditional: 孫堅身上有很多箭，身上的每個地方都很疼。他耳朵裡一點兒聲音也沒有，
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān shēn shang yǒu hěn duō jiàn shēn shang de měi ge dì fang dōu hěn téng tā ěr duo lǐ yì diǎn'r shēng yīn yě méi yǒu
sentences.english: Sun Jian had many arrows in his body, and every part of his body hurt. There was no sound in his ears at all.

sentences.simplified: 他看着黑色的天，有很多话想说，但是什么也说不出来了。
sentences.traditional: 他看著黑色的天，有很多話想說，但是什麼也說不出來了。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn zhe hēi sè de tiān yǒu hěn duō huà xiǎng shuō dàn shì shén me yě shuō bù chu lai le
sentences.english: He looked at the dark sky. There were many things that he wanted to say, but nothing would come out.

sentences.simplified: 他还有很多事没有做，但是都没有机会去做了。
sentences.traditional: 他還有很多事沒有做，但是都沒有機會去做了。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái yǒu hěn duō shì méi yǒu zuò dàn shì dōu méi yǒu jī huì qù zuò le
sentences.english: There was still a lot of unfinished business, but he no longer had the opportunity to do it.

sentences.simplified: 他越来越疼，慢慢地看不见东西了……
sentences.traditional: 他越來越疼，慢慢地看不見東西了……
sentences.pinyin: tā yuè lái yuè téng màn man de kàn bú jiàn dōng xi le
sentences.english: He was in more and more pain, and gradually he could no longer see anything ...

sentences.simplified: 孙坚死了。这一年他三十七岁。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅死了。這一年他三十七歲。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān sǐ le zhè yì nián tā sān shí qī suì
sentences.english: Sun Jian was dead. He was 37 years old that year.

sentences.simplified: 城里的刘表听说孙坚死了，大笑着站起来，说：“太好了！我们打回去！”
sentences.traditional: 城裡的劉表聽說孫堅死了，大笑著站起來，說：“太好了！我們打回去！”
sentences.pinyin: chéng lǐ de liú biǎo tīng shuō sūn jiān sǐ le dà xiào zhe zhàn qǐ lái shuō tài hǎo le wǒ men dǎ huí qù
sentences.english: When Liu Biao, who was still in the city, heard that Sun Jian had died, he stood up laughing and said, “Wonderful! Let’s fight back!”

sentences.simplified: 城门打开，刘表带着军队从城里出来了。
sentences.traditional: 城門打開，劉表帶著軍隊從城裡出來了。
sentences.pinyin: chéng mén dǎ kāi liú biǎo dài zhe jūn duì cóng chéng lǐ chū lái le
sentences.english: The city gates opened, and Liu Biao came out of the city with his troops.

sentences.simplified: 每个人都高兴地大声说着：“孙坚死了！孙坚死了！”
sentences.traditional: 每個人都高興地大聲說著：“孫堅死了！孫堅死了！”
sentences.pinyin: měi ge rén dōu gāo xìng de dà shēng shuō zhe sūn jiān sǐ le sūn jiān sǐ le
sentences.english: Everyone shouted happily, “Sun Jian is dead! Sun Jian is dead!”

sentences.simplified: 江东军队听了，又急又怕，
sentences.traditional: 江東軍隊聽了，又急又怕，
sentences.pinyin: jiāng dōng jūn duì tīng le yòu jí yòu pà
sentences.english: The Jiangdong troops heard this and were anxious and afraid.

sentences.simplified: 都问：“他们说的是真的吗？”有人小声说：“好像是真的。”
sentences.traditional: 都問：“他們說的是真的嗎？”有人小聲說：“好像是真的。”
sentences.pinyin: dōu wèn tā men shuō de shì zhēn de ma yǒu rén xiǎo shēng shuō hǎo xiàng shì zhēn de
sentences.english: They all asked, “Is what they’re saying true?” Someone said quietly, “It seems to be true.”

sentences.simplified: 虽然声音很小，但是大家都听到了。每个人都很难过，他们大声地哭了。
sentences.traditional: 雖然聲音很小，但是大家都聽到了。每個人都很難過，他們大聲地哭了。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán shēng yīn hěn xiǎo dàn shì dà jiā dōu tīng dào le měi ge rén dōu hěn nán guò tā men dà shēng de kū le
sentences.english: Even though the voice was very quiet, everyone heard it. They were all very sad, and they cried loudly.

sentences.simplified: 刘表带着军队杀过去，很快就打败了江东军队。
sentences.traditional: 劉表帶著軍隊殺過去，很快就打敗了江東軍隊。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo dài zhe jūn duì shā guò qu hěn kuài jiù dǎ bài le jiāng dōng jūn duì
sentences.english: Liu Biao rushed over with his troops, and they quickly defeated Jiangdong’s troops.

sentences.simplified: 第二天，孙坚的大儿子孙策来了。
sentences.traditional: 第二天，孫堅的大兒子孫策來了。
sentences.pinyin: dì èr tiān sūn jiān de dà ér zi sūn cè lái le
sentences.english: The next day, Sun Jian’s eldest son Sun Ce arrived.

sentences.simplified: 他带着被刘表打败的江东军队，和刘表又打了几次。
sentences.traditional: 他帶著被劉表打敗的江東軍隊，和劉表又打了幾次。
sentences.pinyin: tā dài zhe bèi liú biǎo dǎ bài de jiāng dōng jūn duì hé liú biǎo yòu dǎ le jǐ cì
sentences.english: He led Jiangdong’s troops that had been defeated by Liu Biao and fought Liu Biao a few more times.

sentences.simplified: 虽然每次都把刘表打败了，但他的人也不多了。
sentences.traditional: 雖然每次都把劉表打敗了，但他的人也不多了。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán měi cì dōu bǎ liú biǎo dǎ bài le dàn tā de rén yě bù duō le
sentences.english: Even though he defeated Liu Biao each time, he did not have many men left.

sentences.simplified: 两天以后，孙策带着死了的孙坚回到了江东。
sentences.traditional: 兩天以後，孫策帶著死了的孫堅回到了江東。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng tiān yǐ hòu sūn cè dài zhe sǐ le de sūn jiān huí dào le jiāng dōng
sentences.english: Two days later, Sun Ce returned to Jiangdong with the dead Sun Jian.

sentences.simplified: 孙策站在河边，看着河这边的江东和河那边的荆州。
sentences.traditional: 孫策站在河邊，看著河這邊的江東和河那邊的荊州。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè zhàn zài hé biān kàn zhe hé zhè biān de jiāng dōng hé hé nà bian de jīng zhōu
sentences.english: Sun Ce stood by the river, looking at Jiangdong on one side of the river and Jingzhou on the other side of the river.

sentences.simplified: 十七岁的他没有哭，他把难过放在了心里。
sentences.traditional: 十七歲的他沒有哭，他把難過放在了心裡。
sentences.pinyin: shí qī suì de tā méi yǒu kū tā bǎ nán guò fàng zài le xīn li
sentences.english: The 17-year-old did not cry. He kept all of his sad feelings inside.

sentences.simplified: 孙坚的助手们站在旁边，他们都很难过，但也很安静。
sentences.traditional: 孫堅的助手們站在旁邊，他們都很難過，但也很安靜。
sentences.pinyin: sūn jiān de zhù shǒu men zhàn zài páng biān tā men dōu hěn nán guò dàn yě hěn ān jìng
sentences.english: Sun Jian’s assistants stood beside him. They were all very sad but also very quiet.

sentences.simplified: 他们都看着孙策，就像以前看着孙坚一样。
sentences.traditional: 他們都看著孫策，就像以前看著孫堅一樣。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dōu kàn zhe sūn cè jiù xiàng yǐ qián kàn zhe sūn jiān yí yàng
sentences.english: They all looked at Sun Ce in the same way they used to look at Sun Jian.

sentences.simplified: 他们知道，江东还有明天，因为江东人还有孙策。
sentences.traditional: 他們知道，江東還有明天，因為江東人還有孫策。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zhī dào jiāng dōng hái yǒu míng tiān yīn wèi jiāng dōng rén hái yǒu sūn cè
sentences.english: They all knew that Jiangdong still had a future because the people of Jiangdong still had Sun Ce.

sentence_translations: There Is Still a Future
Why did the sound of riding on horseback disappear? Where did the man in black go?
Sun Jian found this very strange. As he was thinking about these things, he saw dozens of arrows fly out from behind the trees.
Every arrow was aimed at him. Sun Jian fell off his horse before he could clearly see who had fired the arrows …
Sun Jian had many arrows in his body, and every part of his body hurt. There was no sound in his ears at all.
He looked at the dark sky. There were many things that he wanted to say, but nothing would come out.
There was still a lot of unfinished business, but he no longer had the opportunity to do it.
He was in more and more pain, and gradually he could no longer see anything ...
Sun Jian was dead. He was 37 years old that year.
When Liu Biao, who was still in the city, heard that Sun Jian had died, he stood up laughing and said, “Wonderful! Let’s fight back!”
The city gates opened, and Liu Biao came out of the city with his troops.
Everyone shouted happily, “Sun Jian is dead! Sun Jian is dead!”
The Jiangdong troops heard this and were anxious and afraid.
They all asked, “Is what they’re saying true?” Someone said quietly, “It seems to be true.”
Even though the voice was very quiet, everyone heard it. They were all very sad, and they cried loudly.
Liu Biao rushed over with his troops, and they quickly defeated Jiangdong’s troops.
The next day, Sun Jian’s eldest son Sun Ce arrived.
He led Jiangdong’s troops that had been defeated by Liu Biao and fought Liu Biao a few more times.
Even though he defeated Liu Biao each time, he did not have many men left.
Two days later, Sun Ce returned to Jiangdong with the dead Sun Jian.
Sun Ce stood by the river, looking at Jiangdong on one side of the river and Jingzhou on the other side of the river.
The 17-year-old did not cry. He kept all of his sad feelings inside.
Sun Jian’s assistants stood beside him. They were all very sad but also very quiet.
They all looked at Sun Ce in the same way they used to look at Sun Jian.
They all knew that Jiangdong still had a future because the people of Jiangdong still had Sun Ce.
